parameter.val: The Southern Half of Ouruin was first created by Ouranian refugees during a particularly poor Cicadan cycle. Nowadays, nearly all of the original Ouranian population has been wiped out due to plague, leaving a whole slum to rot in disrepair: Creating the Drowned Streets. The city itself has been marred due to the recent attacks from the Cinderbloods, the native inhabitants of Preuwyn, and the streets are on edge...
